title: Scholarships for Orphans of Veterans
sponsor: New Hampshire Department of Education, Division of Educator Support and Higher Education

award.text: $2,500 for housing, food and books, plus free tuition at NH public colleges

rules.other: Parent was a New Hampshire service member who died on active duty or from a service-connected disability. Free tuition applies at University System of New Hampshire and Community College System of New Hampshire schools. Reapply each year.

description: A state scholarship for children of New Hampshire service members who died on active duty or because of a service-connected disability. It gives $2,500 for housing, food, books and supplies at a New Hampshire public or private college, and free tuition at the state's public universities and community colleges. Apply with the form on the Department of Education's page.
